title: Export Graph (DOT)
summary: Uses graph to export the indexed call/reference graph in DOT format, whole or rooted at a name substring; json and html add the Markdown text nodes
intro: Read this when you want a picture of the indexed call/reference graph in Graphviz or Mermaid. drag-lint graph writes DOT (or Mermaid) for the whole index or rooted at a name substring; also on the IDE Generate & Export menu.

steps: Choose drag-lint > Generate & Export > Export Graph (DOT)...
Optionally give a root name substring
The call/reference graph is exported in DOT format
